title: Academic Writing
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Build a persuasive paper as a whole — from a clear thesis through a structured argument to a defensible conclusion.

steps.title: Frame the question
steps.text: Open with the problem and why it matters, so the reader knows the stakes.

steps.title: State your thesis
steps.text: Put your central claim up front — the one line the whole paper defends.

steps.title: Structure the argument
steps.text: Order your points so each paragraph earns the next; one idea per paragraph.

steps.title: Draft with evidence
steps.text: Support every claim, and make the link between evidence and point explicit.

steps.title: Revise for the reader
steps.text: Cut what does not serve the thesis; fix the joins so the argument flows.

feedForward.text: Write your thesis in one sentence, then list the paragraph topics in the order that best builds to it.
